landscape.say: What does an accessory dwelling unit really cost in Malibu? We break down 2026 prices for every type of ADU, the neighborhood examples, and what moves the price up or down.

landscape.label: 2026 Price Ranges
landscape.title: What an ADU costs in Malibu

rows.name: Junior ADU
rows.note: Up to 500 sq ft, inside the house

landscape.speak: In Malibu, a junior ADU runs about ninety thousand dollars to one hundred eighty thousand dollars and up. A garage conversion, about one hundred fifty thousand dollars to three hundred thousand dollars. An attached ADU, about two hundred forty thousand dollars to four hundred fifty thousand dollars. And a brand-new detached ADU runs about three hundred thousand dollars to six hundred thousand dollars and up.
landscape.say: In Malibu, a junior ADU runs about $90,000 to $180,000 and up. A garage conversion, about $150,000 to $300,000. An attached ADU, about $240,000 to $450,000. And a brand-new detached ADU runs about $300,000 to $600,000 and up.

landscape.label: Rules to Know
landscape.title: Malibu ADU rules to know

tiles.s: The most a city can require
Junior ADUs stay inside the house

landscape.speak: A few rules to know. A city can require no more than four-foot side and rear setbacks. A city has sixty days to act on a complete application. A junior ADU tops out at five hundred square feet. And because all of Malibu is in the Coastal Zone, coastal review comes first.
landscape.say: A few rules to know. A city can require no more than 4-foot side and rear setbacks. A city has 60 days to act on a complete application. A junior ADU tops out at 500 square feet. And because all of Malibu is in the Coastal Zone, coastal review comes first.

landscape.say: What drives the price in Malibu? Coastal review: every Malibu ADU is checked for coastal compliance. Foundations: slabs, caissons or deep piles near the waves. Septic: an upgrade can change budget and placement. Hillside & bluffs: retaining walls, drainage & bluff setbacks. Fire rebuilds: plan the ADU with the new house to share costs. Geology reports: common on canyon & bluff parcels.
